content.text:
I've submitted index 31 (Ca 0.144, Cu 0.177, V 0.679) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.161%, the highest of the three I measured. It's only the best of what I sampled, though: all 3 merit measurements are used up, so better compositions in the library may be untested.

**XRD (4 of 5 used):** The Cu-rich films #114, #116 and #87 share one phase, with peaks at Q ≈ 1.87, 2.37 and 2.64 Å⁻¹; #114 and #116 also show a small peak at about 2.48. The mid-Cu, V-rich film #49 has that same phase plus several extra peaks (Q ≈ 1.47, 2.07, 2.23, 2.93). I didn't identify which phases these are.

**EQE (all 3 used):**

| Index | Ca / Cu / V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 87 | 0.20 / 0.46 / 0.34 | 0.062 |
| 49 | 0.17 / 0.23 / 0.60 | 0.102 |
| **31** | **0.14 / 0.18 / 0.68** | **0.161** |

EQE went up as the films got more V-rich and lower in Ca. Because it was still rising at #31, the true optimum may lie further in that direction. Nearby untested candidates include #26–#30 and the V-rich, low-Ca rows such as #4–#13. I also ruled out the most Cu-rich films (#114, #116) without measuring them, because they have the same phase as the weakest film, #87.
